about: The collecta of the formulary “Palm Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Almighty, eternal God, Who didst cause our Savior to take flesh and undergo the Cross, that mankind might imitate His example of humility, graciously grant that we may deserve both to possess the lessons of His patience and to share in His resurrection. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
